"""Invoice arithmetic."""


def calculate_invoice(lines, tax_rate):
    subtotal = sum(row["quantity"] * float(row["unit_price"]) for row in lines)
    tax = subtotal * float(tax_rate)
    return {
        "lines": lines,
        "subtotal": f"{subtotal:.2f}",
        "discount": "0.00",
        "net": f"{subtotal:.2f}",
        "tax_rate": tax_rate,
        "tax": f"{tax:.2f}",
        "total": f"{subtotal + tax:.2f}",
    }
